explication: lyrion.org is the LMS Community website: its documentation tree provides product, player, plugin, download, and analytics information. The repository also contains small Cloudflare services for bug search, download listings, forum-registration checks, and preview retrieval. README statements establish the site and its maintained-at-deployment data; sampled worker code establishes service behavior. Deployment wiring and unsampled source are not assumed.
